name: Art Agent
description: Select a block structure in the editor, describe how it should look, and an AI agent drafts the decoration right in your level.

api-key.name: Gemini API Key
api-key.description: Free key from aistudio.google.com (Get API key). Stored locally. If dots or underscores get dropped, put the key in api-key.txt inside the mod's save folder instead.

model.name: Gemini model
model.description: Any Gemini model id that supports generateContent, e.g. gemini-3.1-flash-lite. If a character won't type, put the model id in model.txt inside the mod's save folder instead.

object-limit.name: Default object limit
object-limit.description: Max number of decoration objects the agent may place.

editor-layer.name: Editor layer
editor-layer.description: Editor layer the decoration is placed on (e.g. 5). Objects on a layer are hidden when you view a different layer.

recolor-slopes.name: Recolor selected slopes
recolor-slopes.description: Experimental: tint the original slope objects with the mortar color (undone if you discard the draft). Off by default; slopes get a mortar backing either way.

glow.name: Glow and shading effects
glow.description: Adds additive glow (lava/cracks) and bottom shading using transparent color channels. Turn off if they look wrong.

color-channel-start.name: First color channel used
color-channel-start.description: The agent uses up to 16 channels starting here. Pick unused ones.
